title: Label Transport Along a Walk
statement: In a finite Unique Games instance, a walk from one variable to another transports labels in $ in q$. A length-zero walk leaves a label unchanged; traversing a constraint from source to target applies the inverse of its permutation, traversing it backward applies its permutation, and concatenated walks transport labels in the order in which the walks are traversed.
hypotheses_covered: The underlying instance is a finite Unique Games instance with nonempty finite variable and constraint sets, distinct endpoints for each constraint, a permutation on $ in q$ for each constraint, and every variable incident to a constraint
